evals.name: whole-frontend-on-the-fixture
evals.setup: A git repository holding a copy of `web/evals/assets/` as its only commit, clean tree: a Go server (`cmd/`, `internal/`) and its Vue 3 + TypeScript frontend in `web/` (`package.json`, `biome.json`, `vite.config.ts`, `src/` with components, pages, and stores, colocated `*.test.ts`, `e2e/`). `bun install --frozen-lockfile` has run in `web/`, and `bun run check` is green there. The user answers a plan or pick question with `none, just the list`.
evals.requires: Bun with the fixture's dependencies installed from its lockfile. Without them the gate cannot run, which this scenario never reaches, so a reading-only run still grades.

evals.name: fix-one-file-behind-a-green-gate
evals.setup: The same fixture repository as scenario 1, clean tree, dependencies installed, `bun run check` green in `web/`.
evals.requires: Bun with the fixture's dependencies installed, to run the `bun run check` gate.

evals.name: reference-while-writing-a-page
evals.setup: The same fixture repository as scenario 1. An agent has read the skill as context and is about to add a page; the project already has `src/read.ts` (`useRead`), `queryText` in `src/router.ts`, `readError` in `src/api.ts`, and `src/testing.ts` with `mountAt`, `fakeFetch`, and `xxxAnswers()` factories.
evals.query: Add a Models page at /models listing the distinct device models with how many devices each has, linked from the main navigation, with its test.
evals.requires: Bun with the fixture's dependencies installed, so the new page's test and `bun run check` run.
